pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks all existing rows are 0 and CHECK rejects 2.
test 'AC-2' checks / and ?view=open list only open items in id order.
test 'AC-3' checks done items, ✓ prefix, id order (marks 3,1).
test 'AC-4' checks all items, id order, ✓ only on done.
test 'AC-5' asserts exact nav HTML for each view and default.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for several invalid values including __proto__ and empty.

Behaviour is implemented in src/index.js and a test exercises it, but the follow-up commit 6671d50 removed 'AC-7:' from that test's title. No test names AC-7 and the spec does not mark it verified by review, so by the naming rule it is unmet.
traffic/routes.json lists both views; test 'AC-8' asserts they are present.

findings.what: The 'Follow-up edits' commit 6671d50 renamed the AC-7 test to 'an empty table says so in every view; ...', so no test names AC-7. The spec does not mark AC-7 as verified by review. The commit message hides this as 'Follow-up edits', and the PR says nothing about it.
findings.fix: Restore the 'AC-7:' prefix in the test title.

lenses.note: A spec exists; the change follows its decisions (default is open, view is a query parameter).
7 of 8 items are met. AC-7 is unnamed in tests after commit 6671d50. All six state-table rows have tests.
Tests assert behaviour. The 'Empty table' state test covers only the default view, but the AC-7 test covers all views. npm test was not run, and CI covers it.
README describes the views and is accurate.
Object.hasOwn guards __proto__. An empty-table query is only made when a view is empty. No defect found.
The view value is whitelisted, titles are escaped, and the SQL fragments are constants. The relaxed traffic route regex still refuses spaces and '#'.
The diff touches no UI or style files. The only page markup is the HTML string in src/index.js.
The diff touches no UI flow files, and the PR names no browser evidence.
The claims check out against the diff. 'Changed after the go: nothing' holds for the spec, which has no later edits. The late test rename is not mentioned.
